mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE active = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE account_locked = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM refresh_token WHERE revoked = 0 AND expires_at > NOW()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uid) FROM refresh_token WHERE revoked = 0 AND expires_at > NOW()
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_rule WHERE enabled = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM groups_info WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_role WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE last_password_change_at IS NOT NULL AND last_password_change_at >= #{startTime}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS value FROM user_info WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS value FROM refresh_token WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT r.role_code AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT ur.uid) AS value FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_code = r.role_code GROUP BY r.role_code, r.sort_order, r.id ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.id ASC
